Caurapañcāśikā
or caurIsuratapaJcAzikA or bilhaNaº or zazikalAº kāvya. in 50 stanzas in Vasantatilaka metre giving recollective word pictures of secret love situations. Generally ascribed to Bilhaṇa, but sometimes to Cora, Sundara or Vararuci. In one South Indian version it is embedded in the Bilhaṇakāvya. Only 33 verses common to the Kashmir version an. South Indian version. See also Bilhaṇacarita.
